readerCopy.body: A broad promise receives enough structure to support one real piece of help. Someone defines the budget, eligibility, staffing, or deadline required to turn compassion into a shelter bed, recovery program, arts fund, or protected leave policy. Saturn gives the vision limits and responsibility, while Neptune keeps the human need from disappearing inside procedure. The sextile opens a route from intention to delivery, but someone still has to build the container around the promise. The program gains credibility because care is attached to a person, office, and resource that actually exist.
